lastCompletedStory.title: Add test-quality rubric guidance to the cam reviewer agent (.claude copy)

nextStoryContext: Added a 'Test-quality rubric: expanding criterion #2' subsection to .claude/agents/subagent-reviewer.md, inserted right after 'Green tests do not prove correctness' and before 'No-flaky-evasion hard stop'. Covers: (a) 3-clause anti-mock rule (bans tautological 'mock was called' assertions using the warren CONSTITUTION Art. IV aphorism verbatim: "a test that asserts a mock was called is documentation, not verification"; mandates real-I/O at each wire boundary git/tmux/gh/filesystem; explicitly allows behavioral DI-fakes per the CONTEXT.md glossary definition and ADR 0039), (b) adversarial-cases mandate (malformed input, boundary values, regression-of-a-past-bug), (c) per-test discipline checklist (behavior-named tests, one concept per test, success/error/edge triad, waitForCondition from test/helpers/wait-for-condition.ts instead of fixed setTimeout/Bun.sleepSync). Did NOT touch the '8 fixed criteria' count or any other criterion row. This story only edited the .claude/ runtime copy per its notes; templates/agents/subagent-reviewer.md (the generic/embedded copy) is explicitly out of scope here and is the next story's target (prd.json shows a follow-on story requiring the same aphorism/waitForCondition/adversarial phrases in templates/agents/subagent-reviewer.md) — read that story's own acceptanceCriteria before assuming this file's exact wording must be mirrored verbatim, since the generic copy may need de-specialization (e.g. no cam-specific paths).
